data.title: Fluttering Butterflies
data.description: Practice giving a requested number of objects from a larger collection by counting out butterflies carefully.

challenges.instruction: Can you count out some beautiful butterflies? Touch each one as you count!
challenges.hint: Try touching each butterfly one at a time so you don't miss any!
challenges.narration: Let's count these lovely butterflies together in a row!

challenges.instruction: Here are some more butterflies! Can you count them all?
challenges.hint: Take your time and tap every butterfly as you count them.
challenges.narration: Look at all these butterflies scattered around! Can you count them?

challenges.instruction: Time for another butterfly count! How many can you find?
challenges.hint: Go around the circle and touch each butterfly one by one.
challenges.narration: They are flying in a circle! Let's count them all.

challenges.instruction: Let's count this lovely group of butterflies!
challenges.hint: Count slowly and make sure to tap each butterfly just once.
challenges.narration: Another group of butterflies appeared! Let's count them together.

challenges.instruction: Can you find and count all of these butterflies?
challenges.hint: They are lined up! Count them from one end to the other.
challenges.narration: Here they are in a nice straight line. Ready, set, count!

challenges.instruction: Keep up the great counting! How many butterflies do you see here?
challenges.hint: Try counting them in small groups so it is easier to keep track.
challenges.narration: That is a bigger collection of butterflies! Let's count them carefully.

challenges.instruction: This is our last butterfly challenge! Can you count them all?
challenges.hint: You are doing wonderful! Touch each butterfly to count to the final number.
challenges.narration: Let's finish strong by counting our final group of butterflies!
